overview: This paper proposes a Mixture of Low-Rank Mixture of Gaussian (MoLR-MoG) modeling for diffusion models that captures the multi-manifold and multi-modal properties of real-world data, implementing an expert-specific VAE structure and a closed-form nonlinear MoG latent score function to escape the curse of dimensionality and achieve fast convergence.

modules.name: Data Partitioning and Preprocessing
modules.description: Manage dataset loading, standard image transformations, and the assignment of data points to specific subspaces or clusters based on class labels or unsupervised clustering algorithms.

modules.name: Expert-Specific VAE Architecture
modules.description: Implement the Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) tailored for each subspace, including the encoder for projecting full-dimensional data to low-dimensional latent spaces and the decoder for reconstruction.

modules.name: MoLR-MoG Latent Score Function
modules.description: Implement the core Mixture of Experts-latent Mixture of Gaussians (MoE-latent MoG) score function, computing the closed-form nonlinear score based on the learned mixture components (means and covariances) within each latent subspace.

modules.name: Baseline Score Architectures
modules.description: Implement the baseline score networks for comparison, specifically the linear Gaussian score network (MoLRG baseline) and the standard U-Net based latent score network.

modules.name: Forward Diffusion Process
modules.description: Implement the forward diffusion process, calculating the noise scaling factors and adding noise to latent representations according to the defined stochastic differential equation.

modules.name: Score Matching Objective
modules.description: Implement the Denoising Score Matching (DSM) loss function, measuring the discrepancy between the network-predicted score and the ground-truth conditional score of the diffusion process.

modules.name: Reverse Diffusion Sampler
modules.description: Implement the reverse-time stochastic differential equation solver to generate samples by iteratively denoising using the trained MoE-latent MoG score and decoding via the expert-specific VAE decoders.

modules.name: Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Control the main training workflow, including iterating over epochs, routing data to the correct expert VAE and score network, applying gradient descent optimization, and managing model checkpointing.

modules.name: Evaluation and Metrics
modules.description: Calculate quantitative metrics such as the CLIP score for text-to-image alignment and compute qualitative visual assessments by generating image grids for different modeling approaches.

modules.name: Configuration and Logging
modules.description: Manage experiment configurations, hyperparameter settings, logging of training dynamics (such as the loss curves comparing MoG, Gaussian, and U-Net), and integration with visualization tools.
